parsed.rationale: Both `SoundCloudService.fetchMetadata` (line 50 in `SoundCloudService.swift`) and `YouTubeMusicService.fetchMetadata` (line 64 in `YouTubeMusicService.swift`) live in the same `MusicShareKit` package and exhibit a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.808), indicating near-duplicate implementations of the same conceptual operation across two service types. Introducing a `MusicMetadataFetchable` protocol with a `fetchMetadata` requirement would unify the interface, allow callers to depend on the protocol rather than concrete types, and make it straightforward to add future music-source services without duplicating the same method shape. Both records carry no restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` all false), so there is no barrier to the refactor.
